name: annotate_scrna
description: Automated cell type annotation of scRNA-seq AnnData using CellTypist, Leiden clustering, and optional XGBoost
usage: from app.tools.biomni.genomics import annotate_scrna; result = annotate_scrna('input/cells.h5ad', methods=['celltypist', 'leiden'], output_dir='output/')
returns: dict with keys: cell_type_counts, n_cells, methods_used, output_files
